title: Ghostwriter
description: About Us We help established entrepreneurs build media authority. That includes magazine features, TV placements, and book publishing. Our clients are business owners, executives, and industry leaders who want to be seen as the go-to voice in their space. The book publishing service is one of the most personal and high-touch offerings we provide. A book is not just content. It is a credibility asset. It opens stages, closes deals, and defines how a client's market sees them for years. This role sits at the center of that service. WHAT THIS ROLE IS This is a ghostwriting role. You are not writing blog posts or social media captions. You are writing full-length non-fiction books on behalf of our clients. The clients are business owners. Their books are tools. Think: leadership principles, business methodology, entrepreneurial journey, industry insight. The goal of every book is to establish the client as an authority and attract more of the right people to their business. You will take everything in a client's head and turn it into a readable, well-structured, professionally written book that sounds exactly like them. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Get on video calls with clients to conduct deep-dive interviews and extract their story, knowledge, and ideas - Build rapport quickly and ask the right questions to draw out the content they did not know they had - Develop a clear book structure and outline before writing begins - Write in the client's voice, not yours - Manage the full writing process from first interview to final manuscript - Communicate proactively with clients throughout the project so they always know where things stand - Deliver clean, well-organized drafts on schedule - Incorporate feedback and revisions without ego WHAT YOU NEED Non-negotiable: - Proven experience ghostwriting non-fiction books (portfolio required) - Strong client-facing communication skills. You will be on video calls with busy, high-achieving business owners. You need to make them comfortable, keep things moving, and ask smart questions. - Ability to write in someone else's voice and match their tone, cadence, and perspective - Experience structuring long-form content (books, not just articles) - Reliable communication and self-managed workflow Strong plus: - Background in or knowledge of business, entrepreneurship, or leadership content - Experience writing authority-positioning or thought leadership books - Comfort working with clients who have big ideas but are not natural writers WHAT IT'S NOT This is not a copywriting role. This is not an article writing role. This is not social media. If your ghostwriting experience is limited to short-form content, this is not the right fit.

F) Confirm you are willing to abide by a strict No-AI policy for all submitted copy and that you are willing to do your best to help us ensure our output is as organic and AI-proof as possible. Entry-level candidates are welcome: if you can think critically and move fast, we can work with you. Responsibilities Write and deliver content using AI models as a writing aid, not a replacement for judgment Critically review and refine AI-generated drafts for readability, accuracy, tone, and structure Fact-check content and ensure it meets quality standards before submission Follow content briefs, SOPs, and style guidelines closely Complete assigned article bundles within agreed timelines Edit for grammar, readability, and proper formatting Stay productive and proactive: do not wait to be pushed into tasks Requirements Strong English proficiency: written and reading comprehension Ability to think critically and improve AI-generated content rather than copy it blindly Self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and follow-through Reliable internet connection and a suitable work device Ability to follow instructions, briefs, and feedback closely Critical thinking and troubleshooting is essential Comfortable using AI tools for content creation and editing Entry-level candidates accepted: hustle and critical thinking matter more than years of experience Nice to Have Foundational knowledge or genuine interest in the topics being covered Experience with SEO content writing Familiarity with content management systems Background in marketing, blogs, or long-form content Prior experience working in a remote or freelance setting Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) criteria Critical thinking: demonstrate genuine review and refinement of AI outputs, not blind copy-paste Responsiveness: jump into assigned projects immediately without delay Consistency: maintain title: Article Writer and Content Associate
description: We're looking for a detail-oriented content professional to write compelling articles and contribute to ongoing content optimization efforts for multiple client accounts. The successful candidate will have the technical proficiency to independently replicate required styles from reference examples. This role involves identifying content gaps, improving website content, and applying SEO best practices to enhance audience engagement and search visibility. RESPONSIBILITIES - Write detailed, original articles following stylistic and technical guidelines - Perform comprehensive reviews of published pages to identify content gaps, improvement areas, and SEO opportunities - Optimize internal linking structures and anchor text for improved navigation and search engine performance - Support keyword mapping initiatives and assist in organizing content effectively - Identify and resolve keyword overlap issues to prevent content cannibalization - Implement metadata and on-page SEO updates to enhance search visibility - Review and refine heading structures, schema, indexing, and content hierarchy - Collaborate effectively with writers, developers, and account managers - Maintain accurate documentation and optimization trackers MUST-HAVE SKILLS - Strong understanding of technology and websites - Detail-oriented and highly self-motivated - Ability to manage and track personal work with minimal supervision - Excellent written English communication skills NICE-TO-HAVES - SEO experience Important: We value people who can follow instructions, communicate clearly in English, and pay attention to detail. Reliability matters. HOW TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION Provide a link to your resume, a link to your portfolio, and answer the following questions. Please note that the point of asking you to answer the following questions is to enable us to gauge your ability to follow instructions, your command of the English language, your ability to communicate clearly, and your attention to detail. Applicants that do not fully answer the questions below will be ignored. Please answer each question using the same numbering format below. 1. How do you determine whether a piece of content is actually useful to the intended audience? 2. How would you improve a page that has good information, but feels difficult to read or navigate? 3. How do you approach writing about industries or topics you are unfamiliar with? 4. What’s your process for reviewing your own work before publishing? 5. What's something creative or unique about you that we won't find on your resume? 6. How many hours a week would you prefer to work? (40+ full time or if less than that, 'part-time,' please specify). 7. If hired, will this be your second job or your only job? 8. Where do you see your career heading in the next one to three years? Task to Complete Write a 700–1,000 word article on whether you believe you should stay or leave your hometown and why. Include a short explanation of WHY you structured the article and why. Submit your article as a shareable public link. Applications that do not follow the instructions above WILL BE IGNORED.

title: Klaviyo Email Copywriter
description: We’re hiring a full-time Content Marketer to own our content strategy across platforms, with a primary focus on email marketing (Klaviyo) and website (Shopify). This role is full-time and in-house (remote), so please only apply if you’re looking for a long-term permanent position. We're not hiring freelancer or agency. This role is ideal for someone who is creative, strategic, and detail-oriented, and excited to work closely with designers to improve content performance through clear insights, testing, and audience-focused messaging. What You’ll Be Responsible For - Plan, write, and execute email campaigns and automated flows in Klaviyo. - Create and optimize website copy, landing pages, product descriptions, and other on-site content. - Collaborate with graphic designer to produce visuals aligned with campaigns. - Analyze email and website performance metrics to identify what’s working, underperforming content, and opportunities for improvement. - Participate in brainstorming sessions to improve content and campaign performance. - Provide insights and recommendations to improve messaging, tone, and overall content effectiveness. - Analyze website behavior and implement content-driven CRO strategies to improve conversions on landing pages, product pages, and key funnels. - Monitor competitors’ email s, websites, offers, and campaigns to identify gaps or opportunities in our market niche. - Stay up-to-date with DTC content marketing trends and email best practices. Requirements - Full-time, Monday–Friday (9am–5pm PH time) - Remote position - Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to interpret content performance data to make informed decisions - Able to explain insights to non-technical teammates - Organized, self-directed, execution-focused, and able to work independently Nice To Have (but not required) - Experience with Klaviyo or other email marketing platforms - Experience with Shopify or website analytics - Experience in content marketing or CRM/CRO for DTC brands - Familiarity with user behavior analytics, heatmaps, or funnel optimization What We Offer - Competitive salary - Performance-based bonuses - Paid annual leave & public holidays - Fully remote work Application Please send your application via email to ---------- with the subject line: "Klaviyo Email Copywriter – (Your Name)". Include your OnlineJobsPH profile link and answers to the questions below in numbered format directly in the email body: 1) Describe your most recent job: your job overview, and how long did you work there? 2) What challenge did you face, and why did you leave the job? 3) What's the latest skill you self-learned? Why did you upskill on it and how are you using it now? 4) Submit as much of your portfolio as possible. Submitting more work (DTC/non-DTC) will help us make a more informed decision. Strong portfolios outside this role may be considered for other roles. 5) Pick one project from the attached portfolio in question (4) that you are most proud of and answer the questions below. We want to see your ability to clearly explain what you did, your role, your reasoning, and the results of your work. You may optionally pick more than 1 project to highlight additional skills. - What the project was - Your specific contribution - Why you approached it this way - The results or impact (if any) We are looking for your thinking process and specific experience. Overly polished or generic answers with no specific numbers or personal details will be disqualified.

title: SEO Content Writer & Brand Copywriter
description: **About Genesis SEO** We help construction and home services companies win local markets with practical SEO, clean websites, and content that builds real authority. We move fast, keep communication professional, and measure outcomes. ## The Role You’ll own topic-driven content that earns rankings, drives leads, and gets cited by AI assistants. You’ll plan and write website pages, blogs, landing pages, and social/GMB posts. You’ll partner with our SEO lead and developer on site architecture, interlinking, schema, and on-page fixes. You’re organized, proactive, and comfortable showing your work. ## What You’ll Do ### Content strategy and writing - Build a Topic Domination Plan for assigned brands and turn it into an action plan with weekly deliverables. - Research queries and topics using query fan-out, Keyword Planner, SEMrush, regex, and manual SERP/PAA checks. - Write and optimize: service pages, supporting pages, city pages, landing pages, blogs, case studies, and lead-gen content. - Add TL;DR and FAQs to every long-form piece to improve LLM citations. - Create simple content maps to guide site architecture and interlinking. - Coordinate with the web developer to align copy with wireframes and UX. ### SEO + AI/LLM implementation - Review GSC to spot opportunities, cannibalization, and quick wins. - Support AI analytics (using available server logs) to understand how content performs in LLMs and adjust accordingly. - Execute topical authority tactics that strengthen each brand’s core offers. - Plan and maintain an SEO/AI roadmap so everyone can see what ships and when. ### On-page, technical collaboration, and off-page support - Fix keyword cannibalization with URL, title, H1, and meta updates. - Provide schema requirements to dev (and edit JSON-LD when needed). - Build interlinking plans and clean up thin or overlapping content. - QA site architecture issues with services and city-page slugs. - Coordinate off-page asks with the team (GMB posts, citations, basic briefs for links). ### Publishing and social - Manage GMB posts across active clients (manual scheduling where needed). - Draft captions for social and publish announcements for new pages, case studies, blogs, and site updates. - Maintain brand voice and follow approved guidelines; keep a simple content calendar visible to the team. ### Light brand and media support - Create or brief simple infographics to support content. - Request and organize media; do light photo/video edits for web when needed. ## What Success Looks Like (Accountability) - Content quality, accuracy, and SEO compliance meet our standards. - Brand guidelines are followed across all deliverables. - Work is delivered on time and documented clearly in ClickUp. - Feedback from clients and the internal team is applied promptly. - Social and GMB posting is consistent and relevant. - When you apply, write the title of your job post, “SEO Content Writer 49 from,” and then add your name to be considered - Measurable growth: improved rankings, clicks, and conversions for priority pages. ## Your Authority - Make creative decisions within brand guidelines. - Recommend resources needed to do the job right. - Propose content strategy adjustments based on data. ## Must-Haves (Skills and Tools) - Strong SEO writing for web pages and blogs (clear, useful, conversion-minded). - Research skills using: Google Keyword Planner, SEMrush, SurferSEO, Screaming Frog, GSC, and ChatGPT. - Working knowledge of schema types and on-page SEO. - Familiar with Webflow - Comfortable creating and maintaining brand guidelines with designers. - Social copywriting and GMB experience. - Organized in ClickUp or similar PM tools; documents process and decisions. - Professional communication: positive, proactive, solution-focused; camera on during 1:1 and team calls. ## Nice-to-Haves - Experience building topical maps and site content architecture. - Basic design skills in Figma or Adobe Suite for simple infographics. - Familiar with Relume, Webflow components, or CMS collections. - Exposure to GoHighLevel and N8N for marketing automations. - Write and maintain copy for marketing funnels, forms, email s, and texts. - Document automation workflows with clear triggers, steps, and messages

What You Will Do • Review and improve our ClickUp setup • Work with individual tea ---------- mbers to understand how they work • Design and document SOPs • Build and improve workflows and operational systems • Help implement systems and drive adoption • Improve accountability and ownership • Help us d ---------- what should move into ClickUp, what should stay in existing tools, and how those systems should work together • Recommend best practices and challenge poor processes • Build practical systems that are simple and scalable • Help leadership improve operational consistency across the company This is a hands-on role. Requirements • Strong real-world ClickUp experience • Experience building SOPs and operational systems • Experience implementing workflows with real teams • Strong English communication • Comfortable working with remote teams • Strong organizational and operational thinking • Able to work with leadership and department-level staff • Comfortable improving and implementing systems, not just documenting them Nice to Have • Operations, project management, or systems background • Experience with remote companies • Experience with sales, CRM, or business development systems • Experience with Jira, Asana, Redmine, Hubstaff, Slack, QuickBooks Online, helpdesk systems, or related operational tools • Experience with service businesses or technology companies • Experience managing or improving offshore/remote team operations Long-Term Opportunity This role may grow into a larger operational leadership role depending on fit and performance. description: What You'll Be Doing: Once onboarded, your responsibilities will include: - Writing advertorial articles in our proven style and voice using the RMBC II (Stefan Georgi)  methodology - Self-editing and improving your own drafts before submission - Uploading finished articles to WordPress and building out the page - Generating or sourcing images to accompany each article - Following our internal copywriting methodology (full training provided) You'll be a key partner in our content production - not just a writer, but someone who owns the article from blank page to published post. Who We're Looking For: - Strong written English (near-native level) - Solid research skills and attention to detail - Ability to write engaging, compliant copy in the health/supplement space - Comfortable using AI tools to assist your workflow (we'll train you on this) - Self-starter who can check their own work and improve it independently - Basic WordPress skills (or willingness to learn quickly) - Reliable, communicative, and committed to a long-term role Use of AI is completely fine with us - what matters is that you can produce, review, and refine the work to a high standard on your own. What We Offer: - Full training on our copywriting methodology - Support and training on AI tools that speed up your workflow - A clear, repeatable process - you'll never be guessing what we want - Long-term, stable work with room to grow as we scale - Flexible arrangement - full-time or part-time, depending on what works for you - Rate to be discussed based on your availability, output, and the number of articles you can produce per week ??  How to Apply - Required Assignment ?? To apply, please complete the following unpaid test assignment: Write a 2000-word advertorial article on the topic of Menopausal "Joint Pain" using the RMBCII methodology. The reader is a woman (typically 45–60) who has started experiencing aches, stiffness, and pain in her joints around the time of perimenopause or menopause, and doesn't necessarily understand why. The advertorial should provide the reader with the reason for their pain and the solution. ?? Important: You'll need to research the RMBCII copywriting methodology on your own before writing. This is part of the test - we want to see how you handle independent research and apply a structured framework to your work. Your article should be: - Around 2000 words - Engaging and reader-focused - Compliant (no medical claims, no guarantees of cures) - Polished and ready to publish (self-edited) You may use AI to assist you, but the final piece must be checked, refined, and improved by you. We can tell the difference between raw AI output and human-crafted copy - please send us the latter. Submission: Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, please include: - Your completed 2000-word advertorial on Joint Pain (as a Google Doc link or attached file) - A short note telling us: 1. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time 2. How many articles per week you can realistically produce 3. Any relevant experience in health/supplement copy or WordPress 4. Links to any previous writing samples (optional but appreciated) Final Note: We read every application carefully. If your test article shows skill, judgment, and genuine effort, we'll move you to the next stage - a paid trial article, then onboarding into our team. We're excited to find the right person. Looking forward to your application!

title: Looking for a Scriptwriter & Researcher — Geo-Exploration YouTube Channel (Faceless)
job_title: Looking for a Scriptwriter & Researcher — Geo-Exploration YouTube Channel (Faceless)
description: Hey! I run a faceless YouTube channel built around exploring the world through satellite imagery, historical maps, and geographic research — without ever leaving a desk. Every video investigates one specific place: somewhere real, somewhere strange, somewhere that raises a question most people have never thought to ask. I'm looking for a scriptwriter and researcher who can bring these places to life — and keep an audience hooked from start to finish. Here are some examples of the type of content we create ---------- ---------- --- **The tone** Think of an enthusiastic teacher who just found something genuinely weird on a map at midnight and cannot wait to show you. Not a documentary narrator. Not a YouTube host doing an intro. First-person. Conversational. Plain English — if a 14-year-old can't follow it, rewrite it. Enthusiastic but never over the top. The discovery is the story. The facts are what you find along the way. No generic openings. No "Hey guys, today we're looking at...". No "Buckle up!" No BBC documentary voice. --- **Retention is everything** My viewers currently drop off around the 5–6 minute mark. That needs to change. I need a writer who can structure tension across an entire 8–12 minute video — not just nail the first 30 seconds. That means: — A hook that starts in the middle of something, not at the beginning of an explanation — A new surprise, twist, or "wait — really?" moment every 90–120 seconds throughout the video — A mid-video re-hook around the 3–4 minute mark that gives people a reason to keep watching — A payoff at the end that makes the viewer feel like staying was worth it Good storytelling structure. Not tricks. --- **Requirements** — Scripts of at least 1,800 words per video — Delivery within 5–7 days per script (with room to discuss pace as we scale) — Each script includes both the written narration AND a full research/visual package (see below) — Fluent English — natural and conversational, not formal or journalistic — Genuine interest in maps, geography, exploration, or history — Available for ongoing collaboration — this is not a one-off hire --- **What you deliver with every script** **1. The script** First-person, plain English, structured for retention. Editor cues embedded throughout — every scene should tell the editor exactly what to show and which layer to use. **2. Visual research package** A curated list of images, maps, satellite stills, and archival material. Public domain or Creative Commons only. Every item listed with source URL and licence type. The editor opens this list and immediately knows what to use. **3. Map and layer notes** Which historical map overlays are relevant. Where to find them. Which imagery dates to use. Which data layers to activate. Specific, not vague. **4. Source list** Every factual claim verified and cited. Wikipedia is fine as a starting point — primary sources preferred where available. No fabrication. No unverified theories presented as fact. --- **What I do NOT want** — Generic openings of any kind — Complex vocabulary or academic tone — Narration that describes what the viewer can already see on screen — Padding — every sentence must earn its place — Listicle structure — Speculation presented as confirmed fact — AI-generated content without real research and editorial judgment behind it --- **To apply** Don't send a cover letter about your general experience. Don't send a Google Drive folder full of scripts from other channels. Instead, send me **one Google Drive link** with a single document inside: a sample script written specifically for this format. Pick any real-world location that fits what's described above — somewhere verifiable, genuinely strange, worth investigating. Write the opening and first act only — roughly 400–500 words. It must: — Open in the middle of something, not with context or setup — Be written in first-person discovery voice — Include at least two editor cues (what's on screen, which layer is active) — Reference at least one historical map or archival source with a real URL — Sound nothing like a documentary The Drive link should contain **only this one document**. Not a portfolio. Not previous work for other channels. One document, written for this brief. If I have to search for it, I'll move on. **Questions I'll ask every applicant:** — Have you written for a YouTube channel in the same niche before? If yes, share the link. — Do you have experience sourcing historical maps and archival visual material? — What's your realistic turnaround time for a full script + research package? Make sure all samples are shared as Google Drive links — no attachments. --- **Budget** $25 per completed script and research package.

title: Part-Time Content Editor (The Human Layer in an AI Workflow)
job_title: Part-Time Content Editor (The Human Layer in an AI Workflow)
description: Affilino is an SEO agency working with a portfolio of AU/NZ clients across e-commerce, legal, and other verticals. We draft a lot of content with AI, and we run automated humaniser scripts that strip the obvious AI tells (em dashes, 'in today's landscape,' rule of three, sycophancy, hedging, all that). So by the time content reaches you, it already reads cleanly on the surface. That's the easy 80%. We're hiring you for the 20% no script can do. What we actually need from you: 1. Judgment on truth. AI will write 'industry observers have noted' or 'a 2024 study found.' We need you to ask: is that real? Find the source or kill the claim. 2. Lived voice. AI writes like someone who has read about a topic. We need it to sound like someone who has done it. Anecdote, specificity, the small detail that proves the writer was actually in the room. 3. Editorial taste. Knowing what to cut. Knowing when a paragraph is technically fine but adds nothing. Knowing when the intro is buried in the third paragraph. 4. Brand voice memory. We run content for several clients, each with a different tone. A legal client is sober. An e-commerce client is warmer. You'll learn each voice and hold the line. 5. Catching second-pass AI residue. After a humanizer pass, what remains? Often: confident-sounding sentences that don't actually say anything. Generalities dressed as insight. You will hunt these. What you will NOT do: - Run our content through ChatGPT or another humanizer and send it back. We already have that. - Surface-level proofreading. Grammarly handles that. - Generic 'make it more engaging' rewrites. Who you are: - Native-level written English - 2+ years editing experience (publication, agency, in-house, or strong freelance portfolio) - You read a lot. Books, longform journalism, Substacks. You have opinions about writing. - You can tell us, in plain words, what makes a sentence dead - You meet deadlines - Comfortable in Google Docs Bonus: - SEO awareness (H-structure, internal links, search intent) - Background reading or editing in legal, e-commerce, insurance, or finance - You've worked with AI content workflows before and have war stories How to apply: Skip the cover letter. Send us: 1. One paragraph on a piece of AI-generated content that fooled you or your client recently. What was the giveaway when you looked closer? If you've never been fooled, tell us what you watch for. 2. 1-2 work samples (before/after if possible). 3. Your monthly rate in USD. 4. Include the word 'mango' in your reply. Shortlisted candidates get a paid 500-word test edit on real content. The piece will have already been through an automated humanizer pass, so the test is whether you can find what the machine missed. Looking forward to reading your work.

job_title: Direct Response Copywriter & Creative Strategist in one role for 7-8 Figure supplement brand
description: Summary WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer health brand looking for an elite, data-backed Direct-Response Copywriter & Creative Strategist. We are looking for an angle-hunter, a script-master, and a conversion-mechanic rolled into one. We do not write generic, corporate marketing copy, nor do we build standard e-commerce funnels. We create high-stakes, logically airtight, direct-to-consumer health campaigns. If you are the type of writer who relies on basic adjectives, template formats, and surface-level benefits, please do not apply. But if you actively breathe Eugene Schwartz’s Breakthrough Advertising principles, know exactly how to manipulate Market Sophistication and Awareness levels, and execute the RMBC Method flawlessly under tight deadlines, this role is engineered for you. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES End-to-End Creative Strategy & Ideation: You won’t just take orders; you will lead the creative direction. You will deep-dive into market research, analyze ad comments and forums, review customer data, and dream up completely fresh visual hooks and positioning angles to scale our media buying spend. Write Category-Defining VSLs (~3-5 Minutes): You will craft high-retention, problem-aware video scripts utilizing psychological pattern-interrupts and visceral, real-world analogies. You must be able to pitch a severe physical crisis and bridge it seamlessly to a proprietary solution without losing the user's logic or trust. Draft Long-Form Hybrid PDPs: You will reverse-engineer standard, boring e-commerce checkout pages and convert them into long-form editorial landing pages that seamlessly function as high-converting checkout carts. Write Native Advertorials: You will script top-of-funnel presell articles that systematically dismantle mainstream band-aids and open a massive curiosity loop that drives massive clicks to our main offers. REQUIRED SKILLS & STRATEGIC KNOWLEDGE Mastery of Market Awareness & Sophistication: You understand how to market to a highly saturated, highly skeptical consumer base. You know how to take a Problem-Aware prospect (someone experiencing real physical symptoms but clueless about the underlying biological cause) and bypass their defensive walls by targeting a hidden, external enemy. The RMBC Method (Research, Mechanism, Brief, Copy): This is non-negotiable. You must deeply understand how to isolate a Unique Mechanism of the Problem (UMP) and a Unique Mechanism of the Solution (UMS) to form a bulletproof, logical chain. Simplification of Complex Science: You know how to take advanced biological concepts and translate them into clear, simple, punchy, real-world analogies (e.g., explaining bodily pipelines using concepts like plumbing, traffic jams, collapsed highways, or rusted pipes). Visual Storyboarding: You write copy with the video editor in mind. Every line of your script must explicitly dictate a clear, second-by-second visual action, b-roll directive, or high-contrast text overlay to maximize video hold-rates. QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of verifiable direct-response copywriting and creative strategy experience in the supplement, health, longevity, or financial publishing verticals. A portfolio showcasing winning VSLs, long-form landing pages, or advertorials that have generated consistent, profitable ROAS on cold traffic platforms (Meta, Google, YouTube). Direct study or formal training in ancestral direct-response frameworks (Breakthrough Advertising, Stefan Georgi’s RMBC framework, or classic Agora-style copywriting models). High speed of execution. You can research a bodily mechanism deeply, map out a full creative strategy brief, and execute a clean first draft efficiently without endless corporate hand-holding. WHAT WE OFFER Profitable Scaling Environment: Our media buying team is world-class. Your winning hooks, scripts, angles, and landing pages will immediately be backed by substantial daily ad spend. ROAS Bonuses: When your copy and creative strategy wins, you win. We offer direct performance bonuses tied to scaling the conversion rates and average order values (AOV) of your campaigns. Complete Creative Autonomy: No slow, painful corporate committees. We move fast, split-test aggressively, and rely entirely on what the data dictates. TO APPLY: Please send over a brief introduction outlining your experience with the RMBC method, your background in managing Creative Strategy, and 2-3 links to live or past direct-response assets (VSLs, PDPs, Advertorials, or ad briefs) that showcase your ability to convert cold traffic.

description: For this job, exceptional reading comprehension is the most important. SEO Content Editor (Remote, Full-Time) I'm looking for a full-time SEO Content Editor to edit and publish AI-assisted articles for multiple clients across industries like legal, medical, engineering, and real estate. The articles are already written. Your job is to read them, catch anything that feels off — an abrupt sentence, a word that doesn't fit, a paragraph that loses the reader — and fix it. Sometimes that's one word. Sometimes it's a sentence or two. Then you'll add internal and external links, find or generate images, and publish everything in WordPress. A typical article takes 10 to 45 minutes depending on length and complexity. What You'll Be Doing Read articles and make small but precise edits for flow, tone, and readability Add internal links to relevant pages on the same site and external links to credible third-party sources Source or generate images, optimize them for web, and add alt text and captions Publish in WordPress with the correct title tag, meta description, author, and category Submit URLs to Google Search Console and Bing for indexing Requirements Excellent reading comprehension and written English Strong attention to detail Comfortable with WordPress and AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini Reliable, responsive, and able to work 10am–6pm MDT independently Assessment Read the following two sentences and spot the one redundancy with the second one and how you'd fix it. Question 1: Myocardial infarction, commonly known as a heart attack, occurs when blood flow to part of the heart is blocked. This blockage, which can be caused by a buildup of plaque in the arteries, is something that can result in serious damage to the heart muscle tissue if it is not treated promptly and in a timely manner. Question 2: What's awkward about this paragraph? The witness reviewed the report. The report was reviewed by the witness before the witness submitted the report. Question 3: Which sentence sounds more natural? A: The company provides electrical services for residential homes. B: The company provides residential electrical services. You should record yourself doing these assessments with Loom, have the camera turned on and talk through the edits you’re making. Fluent English is a requirement. Put strawberry in the subject line and use 2 AP to apply (no more no less). For your ideal rate, also put $8/hr. This is the starting salary with a $1 per year raise depending on performance. If you put more or less for the desired salary you won't be considered. Free Homepage Design — Web Production Assistant What you'll do: You'll use a pre-built HTML template and AI tools to create custom homepage demos for leads and prospective clients. Each demo takes about 30–45 minutes once you're comfortable with the process. Step-by-step process: Receive a client lead with basic info (name, company, transcript, or CV) Paste the client info and the template HTML into Claude — ask it to return the full updated HTML Generate a logo using ChatGPT (if the client doesn't have one) Find or generate all images (hero, services, FAQ, organization logos, expert photo) using ChatGPT or Unsplash Replace the placeholder image files in the project folder with client-specific images (save files with the correct filenames so they auto-update) Remove any background from the expert/person photo using Photoshop or Canva Proofread the page — check for wrong pronouns, leftover text from other clients, or broken images Do a quality assurance check using the Ask Gemini feature in Chrome Take a full-page screenshot using the Awesome Screenshot Chrome extension Save the screenshot as [ClientName]-[Company]-[Expertise]-website-demo and send it over Tools you'll use: VS Code (to view/edit the HTML file) Claude (to generate updated HTML content) ChatGPT (to generate images and logos) Unsplash (for stock photography) Photoshop or Canva (to remove image backgrounds) Google Chrome + Awesome Screenshot extension (for the final screenshot) What to watch for: Wrong pronouns (especially when the AI assumes gender from a name) Broken or missing images Text left over from a previous client's demo No coding experience required — the process is mostly file management, AI prompting, and attention to detail. Assessments You need the full html but Claude only returned the text content. What do you prompt to get the full HTML? (Shouldn’t be more than 7 words.) You download an image from Unsplash which is a jpg but you need a png. What do you do? Hint: you can change the extension simply by updating the name. (this one requires a quick Loom video. It should take 5 seconds) WordPress Website Tasks I'll train you on everything you need to know, and I provide tutorial videos walking through each task step by step. Your job is to watch those videos carefully and execute the process accurately. If you can follow a process and pay attention to detail, you'll do great here. What you'll be doing: Updating client websites using my custom WordPress theme hosted on Cloudways Swapping out images, text, and page content based on the video walkthroughs I provide Following a repeatable process for each client deliverable Taking full page screenshots and sending completed work to me for review Doing a quality assurance check on each page to catch things like wrong pronouns, broken images, or leftover text from a previous client What I'm looking for: Basic familiarity with WordPress (you understand the dashboard, how pages and posts work) Someone who can watch a tutorial video and replicate the steps without needing hand-holding Strong attention to detail Reliable, communicates clearly, and asks questions when stuck rather than guessing Nice to have: Experience with Cloudways or any managed WordPress hosting Familiarity with image editing tools like Canva or Photoshop You can't have another job while working here. This has to be your full-time job and you have to be very responsive throughout the day through Google Chat. Not listening to the notification is not an excuse. When you’re first hired, the first two weeks will still be more of a probationary period. If it doesn’t seem like you’re learning and producing work efficiently then this might not be the position for you.

job_title: Aviation / B2B Ghostwriter (Remote, Long-Term) - We Built the Machine, You Bring the Magic
description: We're a marketing studio. We ghostwrite LinkedIn posts, email newsletters, and ads (plus other things) for B2B founders in the aviation, career consulting, finance, and home-preparedness markets. We've already built the machine: custom AI tools (Claude plus our tailored ghostwriting skills) and a library of hundreds of client call transcripts to pull stories, ideas, and angles from. But there's a problem with the machine, and it's the entire reason this job exists. Our AI system produces technically accurate, on-brand copy. It'll get you the ideas. It gets the facts right and the structure close enough... But what it cannot do is make someone FEEL something. The emotional storytelling, the visual detail that puts a reader inside a ---------- nt, the human ache that makes a post stop the scroll: that has to come from a person. That person is who we're hiring. So you're not starting from a blank page. We have the AI to hand you the ideas, and we'll work together to build the content calendar. What we need from you is the writing skill to leverage the AI and produce the one thing machines can't: emotion, story, and visual texture. What you'll actually do: - Mine our client's call transcripts for the ---------- nts mentioned above: the turning point, the fear, the win, the detail nobody else would notice - Work with me (and ideally, over time, on your own) to draft the content calendar and the week's ideas - Run our Claude ghostwriting skills to shape and structure the draft. The skill keeps evolving, so your input on improving the system is welcome and encouraged Then do the part that only you can do: - With your edits, layer in the emotional storytelling and visual, sensory detail that makes it resonate - Fact-check every claim against the source. We write about people, companies, and industry data, so accuracy is non-negotiable - Deliver on the content calendar a week ahead of publish date. Volume: Minimum is 8 LinkedIn posts and ~5 email s per week. Once you're ramped and the system's dialed in, there's plenty more: sales pages, ads, additional email work, and eventually copy for our own home-preparedness brand. This grows for the right person. The bar: the founder reads it and goes "that's exactly how I'd say it, this gave me goosebumps." Then I do one light proof pass and it ships. If I'm rewriting your drafts, it's not working out... You're a fit if you: - Write genuinely emotional, story-driven copy in native-level English. - This is the #1, non-negotiable requirement. Show me writing that made someone feel something. - Have real instinct for story: you can hear a 5-minute anecdote and instantly know the emotional hook - Use AI writing tools like Claude as a drafting partner, not a replacement for your own voice and skill - Are obsessive about factual accuracy, attention to detail, and deadlines. This means being reliable and consistent week over week. - I value steady, dependable output over occasional brilliance that fades over time. - Will be honest with me: I've hired talented writers who started strong and faded after a few weeks or months. - I'm looking for someone consistently good who'll be with us long-term. - Take direct feedback without getting upset, knowing we both want the same thing: content that keeps clients around long-term and grows both our incomes Bonus if you've: - Ghostwritten for personal brands, LinkedIn, or newsletters before - Have any exposure to aviation, career coaching, or finance - And experience turning interview or transcript material into content Logistics Remote, long-term, ongoing relationship $800/month to start, raises available and can go up for the right person. I'd rather find someone great and pay them more over time than start cheap and burn through people. Mostly async, but a quick weekly call for content planning (at least early on) would be ideal Begins with a paid trial (below) How to apply: Start your reply with the word CHILLS so I know you read the whole thing. Paste ONE piece of your writing that made a reader feel something, and in one sentence, tell me what emotion you were going for and why it worked. Here's a flat, boring fact. Rewrite it as 2-3 sentences with emotion and visual detail, the way you'd open a post: "A pilot we coached got a job offer from a regional airline after being unemployed for 8 months." Paid trial: Strong applicants get a strong, paid two-week trial. I'll send you call transcripts, our voice guide, and our Claude skill, and you'll produce several posts across the two weeks. I'll of course pay you for the full two weeks. It's how I see how you actually work, and how you find out if you enjoy the system.

What We're Looking For You might be a great fit if you: Have exceptional creative writing skills. You can write like the written content/books that women love to read, such as romance novels or Wattpad. Understand attraction and human psychology Know what makes someone interesting and memorable Can write in different tones and personalities Have experience with dating apps (especially Tinder, Bumble, or Hinge) Understand what catches attention and starts conversations Can make someone's profile feel authentic rather than scripted. The bio and prompts should have a human "soul" into it. Should not just feel purely AI generated. You do NOT need professional copywriting experience if you're naturally talented at writing engaging, attractive, and conversational content. Bonus Points If You: Have experience writing dating profiles Have worked in marketing, copywriting, journalism, or content creation Have a strong understanding of modern dating culture Have a background in psychology, communication, or storytelling Have successfully helped friends improve their dating profiles What Success Looks Like The profiles you write should: Generate more matches Create genuine curiosity Encourage women to start conversations Make clients feel authentic and confident Stand out from the typical boring dating profile Position Details Remote Casual/Flexible hours Work from anywhere Ongoing work available for the right person Paid per profile or hourly (depending on experience) How To Apply Please send: A brief introduction about yourself Any relevant writing samples Your experience with dating apps (if applicable) Follow these steps: 1. Open our Fulfillment Team Tracker: ---------- 2. Pick one of our clients. Using the information the clients provided about themselves, write a Tinder/Bumble bio and 3 Hinge prompts. (If the client did not provide relevant info, just make up one.) The three Hinge prompts should start with... 1. "Together we could... "*insert here the romantic date idea. Be very specific about the details on the date (eg. location, what you're doing during the date) and use vivid imagery to make them visualise what it's like to go on a date with our male client. For example, "Together we could...watch the sunset over a glass of wine at the beach, and talk about our biggest dreams and fears." 2. My humble brag is/My greatest strength is.. *insert here what they are good at. Ideally, it would be something that could be related to the girl. For example, if a client works in sales, you can say "My humble brag is...I can convince you do whatever I want ;)". Another example: "My humble brag is...I'm essentially an expert in female psychology. " 3. The way to win me over is/Win me over by... *insert here a quality (that is not about her looks) that the client wants from his dream girl. The purpose of this prompt is to convey that he has standards, that he won't be satisfied with just any random girl, and to make the woman qualify or prove that she, in fact, possesses the qualities he desires. title: Junior Creative Strategist (Copywriter) For Ecommerce
description: ABOUT ONECOMPRESS Onecompress is a direct to consumer brand selling bamboo compression wear that feels like pajamas to adults 55+ living with pain and limited mobility. Knee sleeves, compression socks, gloves, foot and calf sleeves, and a growing line of topicals. We've served over 500,000 customers, we're scaling fast, and we're very good at one thing in particular: acquiring new customers through paid ads that actually work. That ad engine runs on briefs, and that's where you come in. We need someone who can take proven ads from across the industry and turn them into a steady stream of Onecompress ad briefs, every week, using our SOPs and our internal AI systems. This is not a "wait for someone to assign you a task" gig. We want the person who learns the process, masters it, and then keeps the pipeline full without being chased. THE ROLE One job: turn inspiration ads into winning Onecompress ad briefs. You'll receive or collect proven ads from the industry, adapt them to our products and our 55+ customer using Claude and our internal prompts, and hand clean, complete briefs to our designers and video editors. They handle the visuals and the editing, so this is not a design or editing role. It's a writing, thinking, and process role inside a creative team of strategists, editors, and designers, with real room to grow in scope as you prove out. WHAT YOU'D OWN - The iteration pipeline: a steady weekly flow of completed ad briefs built from inspiration ads, our SOPs, and our internal AI prompts - Sourcing and receiving inspiration ads, then genuinely adapting them to Onecompress products and the 55+ avatar, never copy pasting the original - Correctly classifying every inspiration ad by awareness level (unaware, problem aware, solution aware, product aware, most aware) and keeping your adaptation at the intended funnel stage - Writing clean, natural, direct response copy inside each brief, proofread and error free - Working inside Claude and our internal AI agents daily, iterating on prompts to get better output instead of fighting the tools - Handing off briefs to editors and designers that are so clear the back and forth is minimal, including short Looms when a brief needs explaining - Keeping ClickUp and Slack updated so nobody ever has to ask you where something stands - Asking smart questions when something is ambiguous instead of guessing, and flagging problems in the process before they become problems in the ads WHAT YOU'D BE MEASURED ON In your first 90 days: - Learn the full workflow fast and start shipping real briefs in week one, ramping to 10+ completed briefs per week by the end of month 1, starting with simpler briefs that increase in difficulty as you go - By end of month 2, run the entire process independently, from inspiration ad to delivered brief, with under 5% of your briefs needing rework before handoff - By end of month 2, classify and write for all five awareness levels accurately 95% of the time - By end of month 3, hit full volume and full complexity: 10 to 15 completed briefs per week, every week - By end of month 3, 15%+ of your briefs are becoming winning ads Ongoing: - Winning ad rate: 15%+ of your briefs becoming winning ads by end of month 3, building to 20%+ by end of month 6 and 25%+ by end of year one. A winning ad earns more than 5% of campaign spend and clears the ROAS bar for its awareness level. Our current blended team rate is 10 to 15%, and because this role is iterations on proven ads rather than big swings, your bar is higher. - Sustained output of 10 to 15 briefs per week at the same standard, week after week - Brief quality: no more than two feedback rounds with editors on 90%+ of your briefs WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Copywriting experience. You've written marketing copy before, ideally direct response, and you can read and write long copy in near native English without errors. DTC or creative strategy experience is a big plus. - Real AI fluency. You already use AI tools like Claude in your daily workflow, you're comfortable iterating on prompts, and you're excited that this role lives inside AI systems all day. This is highly beneficial here, not a nice to have. - Marketing literacy. You understand awareness levels and what good direct response copy looks like, or you're hungry enough to learn it fast. Someone indifferent to marketing flames out in this seat. - Process adherence. You follow SOPs exactly and ask before deviating. The number one flame out risk in this role is someone who can't or won't follow process. If "just following the steps" sounds boring to you, this isn't your role. - Patience and attention to detail. You enjoy reading, thinking, and proofreading. You catch the small errors other people miss. - Coachability. You take revision notes without defensiveness and you genuinely want to get better at marketing, not just collect a paycheck. - Clear communication. You take instructions accurately, shoot clear Looms, write clear updates, and keep ClickUp and Slack current without anyone chasing you. - Consistency and follow through. You show up every day, deliver at the same standard, and do what you said by when you said it. - Honesty and high standards. You tell the truth about misses and mistakes, and you don't ship "good enough." WHAT YOU GET - A stable, full time contract role with a fast scaling brand that has served over 500,000 customers - Daily reps inside a serious AI powered creative workflow, the kind of skill set that compounds - Real mentorship in direct response marketing from a team that lives and breathes it - Clear targets, clear SOPs, and clear feedback, so you always know where you stand - Access to our full training library, over $5,000 worth of marketing and copywriting courses, yours to learn from on your own time so you're always getting better - A real growth path: this seat is built to develop into a more senior creative strategist role as you prove out TO APPLY Fill out our application form here (copy and paste the link into your browser): ---------- The form asks about your background, your experience with ads and AI tools, examples of your work, and a few short questions about how you think. Answer everything in your own words. We read every application, and the ones that stand out are specific, honest, and clearly written. If you record the Loom, your application is guaranteed to be seen. Shortlisted candidates will receive an email shortly.

We are NOT looking for someone who generates generic AI articles and calls themselves a writer. We are NOT looking for someone who needs constant supervision. We ARE looking for someone who can take ownership of a blog post from draft to publication while protecting the voice of the brand. To prove you read this entire post, begin your application with the word: WITNESSED ## About Us We are a photography company based in New Jersey serving the New York and New Jersey area. We photograph corporate headshots, personal branding sessions, corporate events, weddings, engagements, and proposals. We publish a large amount of content and need someone who can help transform raw material into polished, professional blog posts that people actually enjoy reading. ## What You'll Be Doing * Publishing blog posts in WordPress * Editing content for grammar, clarity, flow, and readability * Improving weak or awkward writing * Maintaining a consistent brand voice * Formatting articles for desktop and mobile readers * Creating SEO titles and meta descriptions * Writing image alt text * Uploading and organizing images * Adding internal links * Formatting headings properly * Embedding videos when appropriate * Following publishing checklists and SOPs * Occasionally writing sections of blog posts from notes, transcripts, outlines, or rough drafts * Helping identify opportunities to improve existing content ## The Most Important Requirement Writing ability. For example: "The bride was emotional during the first look with her father." That is a summary. A stronger writer notices details, reactions, expressions, body language, timing, and human behavior. If that distinction makes immediate sense to you, keep reading. ## What We're Looking For You should be: * An excellent English writer * Detail-oriented * Reliable and organized * Comfortable receiving feedback * Able to follow systems and checklists * Comfortable working independently * Familiar with WordPress * Familiar with basic SEO concepts Bonus points if you have experience with: * Showit * Yoast SEO * Rank Math * ChatGPT * Corporate content * Wedding content * Photography-related businesses ## This Is Not a Data Entry Job We are not hiring someone to move content from one place to another. title: Full Time for Copywriter For Personal Brand
job_title: Full Time for Copywriter For Personal Brand
description: **Company:** Black Swan Media / Digital Wealth Lab **Reports to:** Head Copywriter **Type:** Full-time **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 4:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Eastern **Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience **About us** We run Digital Wealth Lab - a mentorship teaching corporate professionals how to build AI marketing businesses serving local businesses. The brand ---------- is built on one promise: show people the exact system, no hype, no guru theater. We produce high-performing Instagram content at scale, powered by AI but shaped by real copywriting taste. You'd join a small, senior team where your work ships every day and the numbers are visible. **The role** You'll write Instagram carousels (and reels down the line) for Bruno's personal brand. Your job is to produce copy that stops the scroll, drives DMs, and turns attention into qualified leads — in Bruno's voice, not yours. You'll use our AI content system to move fast, but the words are on you. You write the hooks, shape the emotional arc, polish every line, and make sure each post lands before it ships. Over time you help sharpen the system and the brand voice itself. **What you'll do** - Write daily carousels and reels in Bruno's voice - Use our AI content system to draft fast, then edit and rewrite at the sentence level until it ships - Craft hooks that stop the scroll and CTAs that drive DMs - QA every post against the brand voice, the format specs, and our content guidelines - Hand off finished copy to designers and video editors with clear briefs - Track what's working, what's failing, what's getting flagged - Feed learnings back into the system so the content gets sharper every week - Own the lead and growth numbers from organic IG content **Core skills required** 1. **Influencer / creator experience.** Required. You've written for or worked closely with influencers, coaches, or personal brands — ideally in the business-opportunity, finance, or self-improvement space. You know what creator content sounds like and how it performs. 2. **Social media posting experience.** Required. You've run the day-to-day of posting on Instagram — carousels, reels, captions, timing, hashtags. You understand the platform from the inside, not just in theory. 3. **Copywriting.** Non-negotiable. You write hooks that land, you understand why one slide converts and another dies, and you can shape a full post that pulls a reader from the first slide to the CTA. You write tight, simple, and persuasive — no fluff, no guru hype. 4. **Marketing.** You think in funnels, hooks, offers, and conversion — not just engagement. You can read a piece of content and tell whether it's built to grow followers, generate leads, or sell, and you know when to use which. 5. **AI prompting.** You use Claude or GPT to draft and move faster, you iterate when an output is weak, and you push back instead of accepting the first draft. The AI speeds you up — your judgment is what makes it good. **Bonus (not required, strong plus)** - Theme page / shoutout space - Coaching and info-product space (biz op, high-ticket, masterminds) - Personal brand work for a creator with 100k+ followers - Funnels that turn IG attention into DMs, booked calls, or sales - Ghostwriting or voice-matching — writing in a brand voice that isn't yours **Do not apply if** - Your instinct is to write in your own voice over the brand's. The voice belongs to Bruno. Your job is to write copy indistinguishable from him writing it himself. - You can't tell a good hook from a bad one without overthinking it. Taste is the job. - You've never run or written for a real social media account. - You can't commit to the 4 AM – 12 PM US Eastern schedule, Monday–Friday. - You do not have real results from previous clients - this is not an entry level position. Seriously, do not waste our time unless you are 100% confident that you are an elite copywriter --- **Application Process** **Please read before applying:** Applicants who do not complete and submit the test task will not be considered — no exceptions. Everyone who does submit the full task is guaranteed a response from us, whether it's a yes or a no. **Step 1: Loom Video / Video Introduction** As the next step, please share a 5-minute Loom video or a recording from any video app introducing yourself and walking us through why you're a strong fit for this role. In your video, please cover: - Who you are and your relevant experience - Why this role interests you - Why you believe you're the right fit - How you currently use AI in your work - Any examples of similar work you've done, especially writing for influencers or personal brands and using AI to create or scale content - How your experience connects to the responsibilities described in the job description Please keep the video focused, clear, and relevant to the role. **Step 2: Task** **Part 1** — Go through Bruno's profile ( ---------- ;. Conduct research on Instagram. Come up with 5 post ideas (hooks + post outline) that would fit Bruno's content strategy. You DO NOT need to write the full carousel/reel for this part. Example of an idea: *Hook:* At 20 I was working a 9-5 making $52k. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone around me thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything. *Post outline:* Use Bruno's story and the exact system he followed to explain how the AI marketing business works. Use specific numbers, named tools, and the math that closes (tool cost vs. what the client pays). **Part 2** — Write the full carousel for 2 of the ideas you created in Part 1. You're welcome to use Claude or another AI tool to draft, but we want to see your copywriting — the final words should be polished by you. If you used AI, please attach the transcript of your chat so we can see your prompting approach and how you shaped the output. You have 24–48 hours to share your submission once you receive the document. **Submission** Please submit the following: - Your 5-minute Loom/video link - Your 5 hooks and carousel ideas - The 2 full carousels you wrote - The transcript of your AI chat (if you used one) Thank you again for applying. We're looking forward to reviewing your submission and learning more about how you work.

We have no project management tool and I track nothing, I just do video meetings every now and then and discuss what they're busy with now over chat during the week. I feel like this can be improved a lot. What I want you to take ownership of: 1. Building the machine. Setting up a proper system (project management tool, SOPs, KPIs) so that anytime I log in I can see who's doing what, what's been done, what's next for each person, and what they achieved last week or last month or whatever. I want to know I'm getting my money's worth from everyone and we're moving in the right direction. 2. Keeping everyone productive and accountable without me chasing anyone. I give the general direction ("here's the product, here's what it should do"); you figure out how to make it happen with the people we have, or tell me who we need to hire. 4. Helping me hire and scale through the 10x. Soon I'll need a curriculum writer for the new product, someone to handle photography for the circuits, an SEO person to get us organic traffic on Google (right now we're 100% Meta and I want to diversify), and probably someone to run a more junior creative-ops role under you. We have a small content team in South Africa shooting professional family/kids footage for our ads, and setting up each shoot (venue, cast, coordination) has been a huge headache for me. You've built SOPs, KPI tracking and accountability systems from scratch. 3. You can hold people accountable in a way that motivates them rather than annoys them. This is the part I care about most. 4. Ecommerce experience is a big plus. 5. You're comfortable hiring and managing other people as we scale. title: CREATING STRATEGIST - DTC ECOM UP TO 5K USD/MO
job_title: CREATING STRATEGIST - DTC ECOM UP TO 5K USD/MO
description: Hiring DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories About Growing Pains Marketing Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising. We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter. We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts. This is not just a “make pretty ads” role. We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases. Role Overview As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working. You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality. You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative. Key Responsibilities: Creative Strategy Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads. Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language. Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities. Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research. Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert. Creative Briefs Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators. Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references. Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion. Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed. Meta Ads Execution Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager. Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring. Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns. Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next. Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled. Creative Performance Analysis Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type. Identify why certain ads are working or not working. Use performance data to inform future creative briefs. Track winning patterns across accounts. Help build a repeatable creative testing system. Client-Facing Communication Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed. Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction. Strong written and spoken English is required. You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos. Requirements You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy. You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns. You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager. You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute. You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning. You must have excellent written and spoken English. You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy. You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts. You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories. You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift. We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role. Nice to Have Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories. Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators. Experience writing UGC scripts. Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel. Experience working inside an agency. Compensation Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level. Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis. Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month. If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus. Hiring Process: Step 1: Application You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work. Step 2: Level 1 Test If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test. Step 3: Interview If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview. Step 4: Level 2 Test Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made. Application Requirements Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered. You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy. Application Questions Experience How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy? What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for? Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring. Creative Strategy Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles. What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand? Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible. Research Process What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles? How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers? Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle. Performance Analysis What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working? How do you d ---------- whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative? Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it. Communication This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients? You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process. Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain. Availability & Fit What country and time zone are you located in? Are you available to work some U.S. business hours? What monthly compensation are you looking for in USD? How to Apply DO NOT MESSAGE ME ON ONLINEJOBS.PH YOU MUST submit the following to ---------- portfolio. Examples of creative briefs you have created. Examples of ads you helped strategize. A Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your creative strategy process. Answers to the application questions above.
